abdm_aadhaar_otp: OTP sent to the Aadhaar-linked mobile
abdm_address_hint: 4–32 characters: letters, digits, dot or underscore.
abdm_admin_callbacks_description: The last 20 callbacks the gateway posted to this bridge, with the result of the signature check and how each one was processed.
abdm_admin_facilities_description: Care facilities that carry an HFR facility ID. Each one registers its HIP service on this bridge from its setup page.
abdm_admin_intro: Live view of this CARE instance's ABDM connection: the gateway session, the callback bridge, the registered HIP services and the facilities set up for ABDM.
abdm_admin_no_facilities: No facility has an HFR facility ID yet. Open a facility, then Configurations → ABDM.
abdm_bridge_description: The bridge is the callback URL for this whole CARE instance. It is 1 per client ID. The values come from the gateway.
abdm_bridge_load_failed: Could not load the ABDM bridge setup.
abdm_bridge_register_failed: Could not register the callback URL.
abdm_bridge_services_description: Each row is a HIP or HIU service the gateway holds under this bridge (gateway-list-bridge-services).
abdm_card_unavailable: The ABHA session has expired. Re-verify via OTP to fetch the card again.
abdm_cc_explainer: Share this visit's records with the patient's ABHA so the patient can see them in their ABHA app.
abdm_cc_no_abha: Link the patient's ABHA on the Demography tab first.
abdm_cc_no_records: A prescription or consultation note is needed before this visit can be shared.
abdm_cc_ready: This visit has not been shared yet.
abdm_cc_share_failed: Could not start sharing. Try again.
abdm_choose_hint: Create a new ABHA with Aadhaar, or link one the patient already has.
abdm_consent_note: The patient consents to share their Aadhaar demographic details with ABDM to create an ABHA, and to link this facility's records to it. Care records this consent.
abdm_counter_code_help: 1 to 20 letters or digits. Examples: OPD1, Pharmacy. Do not use the facility ID, the HIP ID, or the HIP name.
abdm_create_abha_hint: Verify Aadhaar with an OTP and issue a new health account.
abdm_error_generic: Something went wrong while talking to ABDM.
abdm_facility_help_facility_id_how: How to get it: Copy it from the facility's Health Facility Registry record on the NHPR portal. It starts with IN and has 12 characters.
abdm_facility_help_facility_id_what: What it is: The ID of this facility in the Health Facility Registry (HFR). ABDM uses it to identify the facility.
abdm_facility_help_facility_name_how: How to get it: Use the exact name from the HFR record. CARE cannot fetch it because the HFR search path is not published.
abdm_facility_help_facility_name_what: What it is: The official HFR name. If it does not match, the gateway can return 2500 Provided facility name is not matched with registered name.
abdm_facility_help_hip_name_how: How to set it: Choose a name patients know. Use 15 characters or fewer. Use no special characters. Keep it unique per bridge on this facility.
abdm_facility_help_hip_name_what: What it is: The patient-visible HIP name for bridge linkage.
abdm_facility_hfr_id_help: Must start with IN and have 12 characters.
abdm_facility_hfr_id_invalid: HFR facility ID must start with IN and have 12 characters.
abdm_facility_load_failed: Could not load the ABDM facility setup.
abdm_facility_name_help: Must match the Health Facility Registry record exactly. Allowed: letters, digits, space, -_.(),/.
abdm_facility_name_invalid: Facility name can use only letters, digits, space, and -_.(),/.
abdm_facility_save_failed: Could not save the ABDM facility setup.
abdm_facility_setup_intro: Enter the facility's Health Facility Registry details and register it with ABDM so that records from this facility can be shared with patients' ABHA.
abdm_hint_aadhaar_help: Only used to send the OTP; Aadhaar is never stored.
abdm_hint_abha-address_help: Like name@abdm — the '@abdm' part can be left out.
abdm_hint_abha-number_help: Printed on the ABHA card. Dashes are optional.
abdm_hint_mobile_help: An OTP will be sent to this number by ABDM. If several ABHAs share it, you will pick one.
abdm_hint_mobile_label: Mobile number registered on the ABHA
abdm_hip_id_help: ABDM issues this ID when the HIP service is registered. It identifies this facility on every record-sharing request.
abdm_hip_id_pending: Assigned after the HIP service is registered
abdm_hip_name_help: What patients see in the PHR app. 15 characters or fewer, no special characters.
abdm_hip_name_invalid: HIP name must be 15 characters or fewer with no special characters.
abdm_hrp_register_failed: Could not register the HRP service.
abdm_link_abha_hint: Sign in with their ABHA card, ABHA address, mobile or Aadhaar.
abdm_link_step_accounts: Several ABHAs use this mobile number. Pick the patient's.
abdm_link_step_identify: Identify the patient with their ABHA card, address, mobile or Aadhaar.
abdm_link_step_otp: Enter the OTP sent by ABDM.
abdm_login_otp_aadhaar_mobile: Enter the OTP sent to the mobile linked with Aadhaar
abdm_login_otp_abha_mobile: Enter the OTP sent to the mobile registered on the ABHA
abdm_mobile_hint: Used for ABHA communication. If it differs from the Aadhaar-linked mobile, one more OTP is needed.
abdm_no_accounts: No ABHA is registered against this mobile number.
abdm_no_bridge_services: The gateway lists no service on this bridge yet. Register a facility's HIP service from its setup page.
abdm_no_counters: No counters yet. Add a counter code to get its QR code.
abdm_no_patient_for_abha: No patient with {{abha}} yet. Register them with the details from ABHA.
abdm_no_shared_profiles: No shared profiles in the last 24 hours.
abdm_not_linked_hint: This patient has no ABHA linked yet.
abdm_otp_system_abdm_hint: The number registered on the ABHA
abdm_qr_needs_hip_id: Set the HFR facility ID to get a QR code.
abdm_registration_hint: Create or link the patient's health account; details are prefilled from ABDM.
abdm_save_before_register: Save the changes before you register.
abdm_section_facility_identity_help: The identity of this facility in the ABDM registry.
abdm_section_scan_share_help: Print one QR code for each counter. A person scans it in the PHR app and shares the ABHA profile. Care answers with a token number.
abdm_share_qr_template_missing: The QR code URL format is not set. Set ABDM_SHARE_QR_URL_TEMPLATE on the server with the placeholders {hip_id} and {context}.
abdm_shared_profiles_help: Profiles that people shared at a counter QR code in the last 24 hours. Open the patient, or register a new patient with the shared details.
abdm_shared_profiles_load_failed: Could not load the shared profiles.
abdm_step_address: Step 3 of 3 — Choose an ABHA address
abdm_will_link_on_save: Will be linked to the patient when you save.
